children: Overview
US patient activation platform's fiscal Q2 revenue rose 10% yr/yr, slightly beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EBITDA for fiscal Q2 rose to $32.9 mln from $22.1 mln a year earlier
Company implemented restructuring plan in May, cutting about 220 positions to reduce costs
Outlook
Phreesia maintains fiscal 2027 revenue outlook at $510 mln to $520 mln
Company maintains fiscal 2027 Adjusted EBITDA outlook at $125 mln to $135 mln
Phreesia expects mid-single-digit AHSC growth and low-single-digit revenue per AHSC growth in fiscal 2027
Result Drivers
RESTRUCTURING PLAN - Co said cost reductions from May restructuring, including elimination of about 220 positions, contributed to profitability expansion
PRODUCT INVESTMENTS - Co said enthusiasm for AccessOne and ProviderConnect products, as well as AI investments, are beginning to impact results
PAYMENT SOLUTIONS GROWTH - Co attributed expanded payment solutions revenue to AccessOne acquisition and integration
